parties.respondent: High Court Of Manipur and Others

summary: Promotion eligibility under transitional rules; application of post-2020 service rules to pre-2020 vacancies; ACR grading consideration period; uncommunicated ACR (2016-17) and premature consideration of newly communicated ACR (2019-20); standard: rule applicable at DPC date governs; viva voce independent of ACR gradings; seniority-cum-merit interpretation; challenge to departmental promotion committee's validity on procedural grounds.
final_judgment: Petition dismissed; Rules 2020 applicable as DPC conducted after their enactment; ACR consideration valid despite timing concerns; no entitlement to promotion based on pre-2020 vacancy dates.
